offers_products.reason: Builds and sells new single-family homes, a manufactured product, as its core offering.

offers_services.reason: Homebuilding sale is the offering; warranty and financing/title support are incidental to home sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells homes to individual homebuyers and families, often via real estate agents.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are individual households; agents are intermediaries, not purchasers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Each home is a one-time purchase by a buyer; revenue comes from new home closings.

cyclical_demand.reason: New home purchases are easily postponed in downturns and sensitive to rates and economy.

big_ticket.reason: A home is the largest, infrequent purchase for a household.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for built homes, not mainly for staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are households buying homes, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Homebuilder invests in land and inventory but uses subcontractors; not plants, fleets or networks.

notes: Asset_heavy is a judgment call because land and home inventory require large ongoing investment.
